frames.narration: A caller invokes add(2, 3) on the proxy. It looks like an ordinary method call.
The proxy does not run it. It makes a request, puts it on the queue and hands back a future at once.
The caller carries on and submits two more requests. None of them waits for a lock.
The worker thread takes the first request and runs it on the servant. Only the worker ever touches the servant.
The worker runs the other two in the order they were submitted. The history needs no lock, because nobody else touches it.
Each result is put into its future. The callers read them when they need them. If a request failed, its error would arrive the same way.
